page_title: CAG 0-2 INT | Cagliari v Inter 28/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+4' Davide Frattesi (Inter) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
90+3' Juan Cuadrado (Inter) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
90+2' Cagliari take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
90+2' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The referee signals a corner kick to Cagliari.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Paulo Daniel Dentello Azzi (Cagliari) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Yann Sommer.

88' Juan Cuadrado (Inter) latches onto a rebound in the box and fires a shot just over the bar. That was a promising chance and maybe he should have done better! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.
87' Juan Cuadrado (Inter) dribbles his way into the box and has an effort on goal, but the ball flies way over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.

86' OFF THE POST! Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) drifts into the box to give his teammate support. He receives a fantastic pass and shoots from close range, but it crashes against the left post. It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
85' Claudio Ranieri prepares a substitution. Gabriele Zappa is replaced by Eldor Shomurodov (Cagliari).
85' A substitution has been made. Ibrahim Sulemana goes off and Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) comes on.
83' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) sees a yellow! His tackle wasn't that harsh, but he probably talked himself into Michael Fabbri's book.
83' A poor mid-range free-kick by Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari) is easily blocked by the defensive wall.
82' Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari) will take a free kick. Is he going to strike the ball directly at the goal? Let's find out!
82' Stefano Sensi (Inter) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Henrikh Mkhitaryan.
81' Caution goes to Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter).

81' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again. Cagliari earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
79' Cagliari try to speed play up by taking a quick free kick.
79' Michael Fabbri blows his whistle for a foul after Marko Arnautovic (Inter) hacks down one of his opponents. It's a free kick to Cagliari in a dangerous position.
77' Simone Inzaghi has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Marko Arnautovic (Inter) replacing Marcus Thuram.
75' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Alessandro Bastoni (Inter).
73' PENALTY APPEAL after Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
71' Nicolo Barella comes off the pitch to be replaced by Davide Frattesi (Inter).
71' Simone Inzaghi has decided to make a change. Carlos Augusto (Inter) replaces Federico Dimarco.
71' Here comes a substitution. Denzel Dumfries is given a rest as he is replaced by Juan Cuadrado (Inter).
70' Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
68' Federico Dimarco (Inter) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Cagliari.
65' Stefan de Vrij (Inter) plants his close-range header just wide of the left post after a cross into the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.
63' The Inter players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
61' Federico Dimarco (Inter) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball is out of play. Cagliari will have a throw-in.
60' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Paulo Daniel Dentello Azzi (Cagliari) comes onto the pitch for Jakub Jankto.
58' Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross. The ball goes out of play and Inter will have a goal kick.
55' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) takes it short.

55' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. It will be a corner kick for Cagliari.
52' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
52' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
51' Marcus Thuram (Inter) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
49' Inter enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
47' Alessandro Di Pardo (Cagliari) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Claudio Ranieri probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Gaetano Oristanio. He is replaced by Alessandro Di Pardo (Cagliari).
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' The ball rebounds outside of the penalty area and falls to Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) who directs his shot to the middle of the goal, but the keeper is there to stop his effort.
45+2' Cagliari failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
45+2' Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. Cagliari force their opponents to concede a corner.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
45' The resulting corner from Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) comes to nothing.
45' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. Inter have a corner.
44' Federico Dimarco (Inter) launches a cross from the corner, but Boris Radunovic is alert to thwart the effort.
44' Federico Dimarco (Inter) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball goes out of play and Inter have been awarded a corner kick.
42' A cross from Federico Dimarco (Inter) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
41' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball is out of play. Inter will take a throw-in.

40' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) times his run and jump perfectly to get on the end of the resulting corner, but the ball comes off the top of his head and goes miles over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.
40' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.

39' Federico Dimarco (Inter) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Inter will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
36' Federico Dimarco (Inter) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
35' Substitution. Leonardo Pavoletti is replaced by Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari).
34' Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

33' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball goes behind for a corner. Inter will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
30' 0 - 2 Goal! Lautaro Martinez (Inter) finds himself some space inside the box to get on the end of a pass from Federico Dimarco, then sends the ball into the bottom left corner. 0:2.
29' Ball possession – 28:72.
29' Inter seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.

27' Gabriele Zappa slings in a great lofted ball towards Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari), who doesn't get the best of contacts but still sends a close-range header inches wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Inter.

26' Chance! Denzel Dumfries (Inter) comes within inches of scoring after picking up a pass from Nicolo Barella, but his shot from inside the box flashes inches wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.
24' Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.

24' What a great touch by Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the bottom left corner, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending. The ball is out of play. Cagliari win a corner kick.
21' 0 - 1 Goal! A great through ball by Marcus Thuram sets up Denzel Dumfries (Inter) inside the box, and he makes no mistake and bangs the ball into the bottom left corner. 0:1.
21' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Federico Dimarco (Inter), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
17' Marcus Thuram (Inter) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.

16' What a chance that is! Nahitan Nandez swings the ball into the box, and Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari) gets in front of his man and powers his header just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Inter will have a goal kick.
14' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) fails to score from inside the six-yard box as his rebound hits the right-hand post.
12' The Inter players are exchanging some short passes.
8' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Boris Radunovic intercepts the ball.
8' Federico Dimarco (Inter) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
7' He should have scored! Lautaro Martinez (Inter) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block. Inter will take a corner kick.

5' Nicolo Barella (Inter) covers his face with his hands after wasting a promising chance. He takes the rebound on the edge of the box but blazes the ball high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.
4' Federico Dimarco (Inter) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
4' Federico Dimarco (Inter) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. Now Inter have a corner.
2' Jakub Jankto (Cagliari) sends a long ball in, but Yann Sommer comfortably gathers the ball.

2' A lofted cross from Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The ball is behind the touchline and Cagliari will take a throw-in.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Cagliari will take the kick-off.
Michael Fabbri got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
